_forecast_note: forecast_override is the committed-scope forecast (73), used instead of the 5-release regression because the Bugs Bunnies + Guardians teams left. Set to null to fall back to the regression.
_first_send_date_note: Manager sends are suppressed before this date. Kobi asked for the distribution to start Mon Aug 10 2026; the cron alone would have fired Thu Aug 6.
_recipients_note: Recipient addresses are NOT in this file -- the repo is public. Managers come from the PMN_DASHBOARD_RECIPIENTS secret (semicolon-separated); the test audience comes from PMN_DASHBOARD_TEST_RECIPIENT.
